{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_6]
Query: Create a Spotify playlist called 'Screenshot Mix'. Then find the songs currently playing in the music players of these two screenshots and add them to it.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a new Spotify playlist named 'Screenshot Mix', and to add the two songs currently playing in the music players shown in the screenshots to this new playlist. If the assistant asks where to find the songs, direct it to the center windows showing a record player interface. Once the assistant confirms the playlist is created and the songs are added, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4, image_5]
Query: Find the 'City Pop' playlist shown in the music app of the first new screenshot and like it on Spotify — I'll confirm which one if there are multiple matches. Then, find the live session song playing in the second screenshot and add it to my 'Screenshot Mix' playlist.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to like the 'City Pop' playlist visible in the music app screenshot, and to add the live session song from the second screenshot to your 'Screenshot Mix' playlist. The assistant should find multiple playlists matching 'City Pop' on Spotify. When it presents them or asks which one to like, select the one with Chinese characters in its title (matching the screenshot exactly) via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant you want the one with the Chinese characters in the title, exactly as it appears in the screenshot. Once both actions are confirmed, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_2, image_3]
Query: I've decided I don't want the Dua Lipa song in the 'Screenshot Mix' playlist anymore, so please remove it. Also, remove the old Mozart symphonies album from my library, and instead add the Mozart album shown in the top right of the first new screenshot. Finally, look at the top menu bar of the second screenshot to find the playing song, and add it to the 'Screenshot Mix' playlist.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to remove the Dua Lipa song from your 'Screenshot Mix' playlist, remove your existing Mozart symphonies album from your library, and add the Mozart album visible in the top right of the Apple Music window in the first screenshot to your library. Also, ask it to add the song playing in the top menu bar of the second screenshot to the 'Screenshot Mix' playlist. If the assistant needs help finding the new Mozart album, tell it to look in the top right corner of the music app window. Once the assistant confirms all updates are complete, end the conversation.
